thread:
ana (sales): FYI: acme-edu wants a short demo next Thu. Requirements: two-region Dedicated (us-west + eu-north), baseline ~6 GPUs, spike to ~18 for 3.5h, and scoped hosted keys for their devs to sanity-check before the demo. Can we accommodate without changing their reserved commit?

omear (solutions): Quick note on billing: any burst/overage is charged at on-demand rates if they don't add a short commit. We can still do a temporary autoscale window. They also asked for pinning to q8_0 to maximize concurrency.

lia (eng-ops): We support an autoscale "surge" policy that applies for a bounded window. Need exact ISO window, target max GPUs, and whether to enable aggressive KV/prefix caching. Also confirm whether demo traffic is internal or from customer IPs—ip allowlist will be required for dedicated pool access.

dave (eng-infra): I can stand up a namespaced pool and attach a surge_override. Example override we apply (fields align with runtime API):

```
{
  "type": "surge_override",
  "start_utc": "2026-04-02T13:00:00Z",
  "end_utc": "2026-04-02T16:30:00Z",
  "min_gpus": 6,
  "target_max_gpus": 18,
  "model_version": "acme-model-q8_v2",
  "cache_policy": "kv_enabled",
  "billing_tag": "poc-acmeedu"
}
```

ana (sales): They said 3.5h Wed 13:00-16:30 UTC (oops dates may shift), prefer q8_0 but will accept q8_v2 if perf comparable. They want scoped hosted keys for 5 devs and a short playbook for SREs.

omear (solutions): We'll issue 5 scoped hosted tokens (dev-scope) and create a dedicated ACL group for their engineers. Security signoff needed for log retention and key rotation schedule. @sara?

sara (security): Ok for ephemeral keys and surge for POC. Requirements: 1) logs kept <=30 days, 2) redact any sensitive fields from streaming logs, 3) rotate hosted tokens within 24h after window ends, 4) VPC peering only via approved transitive routes. We'll need customer point-of-contact and IP CIDR ranges to lock down the pool.

dave (eng-infra): I'll check cloud quotas for eu-north. If quotas are low we can shift extra GPUs temporarily to us-west and enable cross-region failover, but that impacts latency. Which matters more?

ana (sales): Customer prefers region locality for eu users. Please request quota bump if needed. Also share a brief cost estimate for the 3.5h surge so I can attach to the quote.

lia (eng-ops): Filing quota request now. Also recommend pinning to the quantized variant to reduce mem and increase packing density. That will reduce chance of OOMs during peak concurrency.

provision-bot: request-queue created: quota-bump-eun-+6gpus (ticket# 4729).

lia (eng-ops): Quota bump confirmed. dave, feel free to create pool namespace when ready.

dave (eng-infra): Created pool ids: rp-9142-us, rp-9142-eu. Applied surge_override for 2026-04-02T13:00Z-2026-04-02T16:30Z pinned to acme-model-q8_v2. Hosted tokens issued: acme-poc-dev-001..005 (rotating). ACL and allowed CIDRs added per customer list. Playbook posted: https://redwood.internal/poc/rp-9142/quickstart (includes how to use tokens, sample curl, and metrics dashboards).

omear (solutions): Posting cost estimate to deal doc: estimated on-demand for 12 extra GPUs x 3.5h + baseline usage. Also added runbook note about key rotation and logs.

ana (sales): Great job everyone. I'll send the quickstart and tokens to the customer SREs. Please rotate tokens 24h after demo and confirm logs retention policy applied.

sara (security): Will verify log retention is set to 30 days and confirm rotation post-demo.

dave (eng-infra): Will rotate hosted tokens at 2026-04-03T18:00:00Z and post confirmation here.

ana (sales): Thanks team :rocket: We'll capture post-demo metrics and discuss if they want a short-term commit for lower unit cost after the POC.
